positions.locationName: East Palo Alto, California, United States
positions.description:
Improved Redshift's Data Sharing query performance by implementing various metadata management optimizations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on Redshift AQUA's storage and memory management layer. We used SPDK's blob store to allow query execution engines to fetch filtered data from storage via the FPGA accelerator.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
In-Storage Computation Filesystem
Implemented a FUSE-based filesystem that transparently allowed applications to register and utilize in-storage accelerators using POSIX APIs. 
Implemented runtime manager for scheduling and orchestrating data transfer between NVMeoF-based computational storage devices, enabling P2P acceleration.

company.name: UCLA Henry Samueli School of Engineering and Applied Science

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Designed and implemented content addressable memory (CAM) to accelerate set inclusivity queries run on Redshift's AQUA FPGA accelerator.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.locationName: Stony Brook, New York, United States
positions.description:
FPGA Accelerated Formal Verification
Implemented an overlay architecture on FPGA to enable programmable model checking with the help of a basic compiler to convert Promela models to the custom ISA. 
TRETS Journal Paper: https://doi.org/10.1109/FPL.2019.00018

Software-Hardware Co-Simulation Platform
Implemented a lock-step simulation platform based on QEMU and HDL Simulators that allowed the lab to debug and test OS changes as well as hardware design changes. 
FPGA Paper: https://doi.org/10.1109/FPL.2019.00018

DNS Analytics
Developed an ingestion pipeline based on ElasticSearch to process the evolution of DNS domain names registered with ICANN and Verisign.
